subject: Runway decision canvas: VPC / on-prem feasibility for Bluehaven pilot
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runway decision canvas: VPC / on-prem feasibility for Bluehaven pilot

Team —

Bluehaven (Sophie Chen, ops@bluehaven.com) is asking for a short feasibility run to confirm whether we can support their pilot in a customer-managed VPC with optional on-prem packaging. This is a typical cross-functional ask: product needs scope clarity, infra needs to validate runtime constraints and staffing, security needs to map the compliance artifacts, and legal/procurement will likely ask for hosting guarantees.

I want us to produce a lightweight "runway decision canvas" that surfaces:
- concrete scope (APIs/features required, data residency and retention)
- infeasibility risks (air-gap, HSM/KMS constraints, network topology)
- estimated SRE/Ops headcount and runbook gaps for pilot support
- a short-cost/latency tradeoff callout (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- a recommended go/no-go and what decision triggers an exception route

Request: can Soojin and Karthik take the lead on a 10-working-day sprint to produce the draft canvas + one-pager for leadership review? I'd like a strawman by EOD 2025-06-26 so we can sync with Product and Sales. Please call out any blockers (legal templates, SOC2 evidence, infra quotas) in your reply.

Attachments: none yet — I'll upload our last pilot canvas as a template to the Drive linked below.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
(Attachment stub: previous_runway_canvas_v1.pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway decision canvas: VPC / on-prem feasibility for Bluehaven pilot

Naomi — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to lead the canvas with Karthik. Quick reactions / scope clarifications from infra/security POV:

- Bluehaven said they need a VPC-hosted endpoint + optional air-gapped appliance for PII workloads. Need exact list of endpoints and whether embeddings are in-scope.
- KMS: they prefer customer-managed keys in KMS/HSM. We should confirm supported providers (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault) and whether HSM integration is an exception.
- Network: will they be doing egress-only connection to Redwoods' control plane, or full bidirectional peering? The latter raises NAT and routing concerns.
- SLAs: sales will ask for latency SLOs; pilot should set realistic expectations (best-effort vs SLA-backed).

I'll attach the first draft canvas and a short ops resourcing sheet. Can Karthik validate the runtime/quantization constraints and whether a quantized model variant is necessary for the appliance?

Deliverables planned by 2025-06-26 EOD: runway_canvas_draft.pdf, ops_resourcing_estimate.xlsx, and a 1-page decision memo. If Legal or Security require templates, loop them in; else we'll annotate gaps.

Attaching: runway_canvas_draft.pdf (draft), ops_resourcing_estimate.xlsx (draft)

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Staff Engineering Manager — Infra
(Attachment stubs: runway_canvas_draft.pdf, ops_resourcing_estimate.xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-23T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway decision canvas: VPC / on-prem feasibility for Bluehaven pilot

Thanks — read the draft. A few technical feasibility notes and proposed action items: 

1) Model runtime and packaging
- For the appliance: we can support a quantized LLM variant (Q4 or int8) to reduce memory, but that requires validation on their production prompts; perf could degrade on long-context workloads.
- We should identify 2 model candidates: 1) hosted+dedicated variant (no extra packaging), 2) appliance-optimized model (strip mixed-precision ops).

2) Networking and control plane
- If Bluehaven requires zero outbound to public endpoints (air-gapped), we need a signed-off offline install and an ops image with an offline installer. That increases scope and costs by ~3-4x for pilot support.
- If they allow outbound to our control plane over a firewall/proxy, we can keep a normal private deployment path which is much cheaper operationally.

3) Resourcing estimates (high level) — for a 6-week pilot:
- 0.6 FTE infra lead (sprint and packaging)
- 0.4 FTE runtime engineer for model validation and quantization testing
- 0.3 FTE SRE for on-call rotation (pilot window)
- + 0.2 FTE security liaison for artifact packaging and KMS mapping

4) Blockers / needs
- Legal: clarify indemnity and data retention limits early.
- Security: access to their compliance artifacts (network diagrams, HSM certs) is required to finalize scope.
- Capacity: need estimate on sustained concurrency to size GPUs for dedicated pools.

I recommend we categorize the decision canvas into three tracks (A: supported w/o exception; B: supported with exceptions and extra ops; C: not supported without product change). I can add rough cost multipliers in the ops_resourcing_estimate.xlsx.

I'll include a short technical appendix in the draft describing the offline-install constraints.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Architect — Serving Runtime
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@bluehaven.com>
Date: 2025-06-24T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway decision canvas: VPC / on-prem feasibility for Bluehaven pilot

Appreciate the thoroughness. Good call on the three-track decision framing — that's exactly what leadership wants to see.

Next steps:
- Soojin / Karthik: finalize the draft canvas + resourcing workbook by 2025-06-26 EOD and upload to the Drive link.
- Marissa: can you prepare a 10-minute leadership kickoff for 2025-06-30 to review the canvas and the ask for a pilot budget?
- Sophie / Bluehaven: Sophie, can you confirm whether the appliance must be fully air-gapped or if an outbound-only control channel is acceptable? That will materially change our recommendation.

If no major blockers are called out by EOD next Thursday, I'll queue this for the leadership review.

Thanks — Naomi
